finding: The current low-memory fish checkpoint misses 8 of 10 user images even at confidence 0.10; this is not primarily a threshold problem.
interpretation: Current low-memory checkpoint was trained/evaluated on a different visual domain and at a low-memory 320px training setup.
User photos include aquarium/clean-background, close-up, cropped, high-resolution and different species/appearance than the small Fish4Knowledge validation frames.
The historical checkpoint detects more user images, but its extra boxes are not ground-truth verified and must not be substituted silently.
A lower confidence threshold alone cannot recover most misses from the current checkpoint.
recommended_action: Collect 30-100 representative target-domain fish images, annotate boxes, split by source/session, then fine-tune or retrain and evaluate on a locked target-domain test set.
